_comment: SCA (src/ + xpi/) whose shipped XPI ships a minified background.js, so the review stays in SCA mode (not downgraded to sca-not-required) and the input:build checks run over the src/ build corpus. Each build-hygiene check fires twice, so their collapse behaviour is observable: build-lifecycle-hook on the postinstall and prepare scripts (warning); committed-build-artifact on the committed dist/addon.zip and dist/legacy.xpi (error, archive extension only - contents irrelevant); committed-node-modules on both committed dependency folders (error, never read - the loader records the directory path only, which is why the repo .gitignore re-includes fixture node_modules); build-registry-redirect on both .npmrc files, since a build can run from a subfolder (error, the raw value is not parsed). unsupported-build-tool reports the committed yarn.lock; exactly one finding is possible there, since the check returns on the first tool it recognises. Build-corpus paths are sca-root-relative (no src/ prefix).
